name: schema-mapper
description: Transforms and validates streaming records against a schema with data mapping rules, default value injection, and type coercion.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when incoming stream records have mismatched fields, require normalization, conversion of string fields to actual numbers or dates, or filtering of records failing structural schema constraints.

parameters.name: schema
parameters.description: Schema definition mapping fields to types, renames, default values, and custom rules.
